articles.summary: More than half of the hotels in Germany, Austria and Switzerland lead with their restaurant. Where one number serves both, a room inquiry lands on the restaurant's line.
articles.title: When the Restaurant Line Is the Hotel Line

articles.summary: Three out of four group inquiries in one hotel-call sample were new conversations. A group call is a lead, and it needs a path that keeps the request intact when the group desk is closed.
articles.title: What Happens When a Group Calls

articles.summary: For most hotels, the AI should answer first. After roughly 20 seconds of ringing, callers assume voicemail. Backup-only fits a house where one person takes every call.
articles.title: Should a Hotel's AI Answer First, or Only When Reception Doesn't? | Codyco
